purpose: Machine-checkable binding between the claims the manuscript asserts and the archived evidence that supports them. Verified by scripts/check_claim_ledger.py. Sentences are curated, never auto-regenerated: when a sentence drifts the checker fails so a human re-verifies the claim instead of the ledger silently absorbing the change.
matching_rule: A stored sentence is compared to its manuscript region with every number replaced by a placeholder; each number slot is then bound in order of appearance to an artifact key and compared against the archived value. Slot count must equal binding count.

claims.sentence: In a frozen 20-task complete-gold controlled index, full ORION reaches mean recall 0.994444 versus 0.666667 for the strongest protocol-frozen confirmatory comparator and makes no premature task closures; targeted negative ablations expose the intended failure modes.
claims.note: Headline abstract comparison on the frozen controlled index.

claims.sentence: The frozen statistical plan classifies this campaign DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY, so these numbers support mechanism behavior rather than an inferential superiority claim.
claims.note: Authority self-limitation; the artifact records DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.

claims.sentence: No external Wide/Deep system result is archived in this revision; real scientific-literature discovery benefit therefore remains CANNOT_CHECK.
claims.note: Negative external status. No archived Wide/Deep system outcome exists.

claims.sentence: The frozen controlled-index companion supports a narrow engineering result: under a complete denominator and matched host-owned budgets, the route/read/stopping governance mechanisms behave in the intended fail-closed directions, and the strongest confirmatory controlled comparator still leaves substantial reachable gold.
claims.note: Conclusion mechanism statement.

claims.sentence: The paper's externally supported discovery/stopping claim remains open until denominator-valid Wide/Deep or other admissible external results are archived; if they do not support the planned promotion rule, the claim must remain narrowed rather than promoted.
claims.note: Conclusion holds the external claim open.

claims.sentence: The observed +0.327777 recall difference therefore cannot be transferred to the open web or to AutoResearchBench by analogy.
claims.note: Non-transferability of the descriptive difference.

claims.sentence: The suite has only 20 tasks.
claims.note: Suite size. Bound to the world manifest so a scale-up cannot be forgotten here.

claims.sentence: The frozen statistics plan set 97 tasks as the lowest inferential tier before outcomes were inspected, so the offline campaign is descriptive even though all 840 system/task/repeat executions reproduce exactly.
claims.note: Inferential-tier shortfall and executed record count.

claims.sentence: Three deterministic repeat seeds demonstrate stable execution; they do not increase the statistical unit.
claims.note: Repeats test harness stability only.

claims.sentence: The access audit establishes evaluator and artifact availability, not benchmark performance.
claims.note: Audit establishes availability, not performance.

claims.sentence: Removing the question coordinate from the read ledger changes legitimate reread behavior but does not change aggregate recall in this suite; removing the unavailable-route open state changes censoring/closure semantics while leaving aggregate recall numerically unchanged.
claims.note: Null-on-recall mechanism findings retained as nulls.

claims.sentence: It contains 20 tasks, 14 systems (full ORION, six confirmatory baselines, one explicitly exploratory comparator, and six ablations), and three predeclared repeat seeds, for 840 normalized run records.
claims.note: Campaign shape.

claims.sentence: The systems are deterministic; the repeats therefore test harness stability and do not increase the statistical unit beyond 20 tasks.
claims.note: Determinism does not raise the statistical unit.

claims.sentence: The frozen statistical plan requires at least 97 tasks for its lowest inferential tier.
claims.note: Lowest inferential tier from the frozen plan.

claims.sentence: It binds the full 840-record set by SHA-256 611808dc80846d5057c84c12af7ff8ec3fa88ef15a6ede91807e590f4edb6f1f and the corresponding rich-artifact hash list by 2da59dc21e6473e4a81eb93910501a67bed008dbc3e29c26116041b68dfbb325.
claims.note: Record-set digest binding.

claims.sentence: Full ORION attains mean complete-gold recall 0.994444 and precision 1.0.
claims.note: ORION recall and precision.

claims.sentence: It passes 19 of 20 tasks and returns CANNOT_CHECK on the remaining task because a route holding unretrieved relevant material becomes unavailable; it never certifies that censored task complete.
claims.note: Pass/censored split.

claims.sentence: Its premature-task-closure rate is 0.
claims.note: ORION premature closure rate.

claims.sentence: The strongest of the six protocol-frozen confirmatory baselines is the protocol-driven systematic-review comparator, with mean recall 0.666667.
claims.note: Strongest confirmatory comparator.

claims.sentence: That comparator claims task completion on all 20 tasks while reachable gold remains, so its premature-closure rate is 1.0.
claims.note: Comparator closes prematurely on every task.

claims.sentence: The descriptive recall difference is therefore +0.327777, with a descriptive premature-closure difference of -1.0.
claims.note: Descriptive differences, both signs bound.

claims.sentence: The protocol-driven comparator then reaches mean recall 0.666667 by query 7 and remains at that value through query 12.
claims.note: Comparator plateau on the query axis.

claims.sentence: ORION is at 0.727778 by query 7 and continues to gain, reaching 0.994444 by query 12.
claims.note: ORION continues gaining past the shared prefix.

claims.sentence: Removing the route-independence check reduces mean recall to 0.444444 and produces premature closure on every task.
claims.note: H2 negative ablation.

claims.sentence: Allowing a route stop to certify task closure yields recall 0.333333 with the same 100% premature-closure rate.
claims.note: H3 negative ablation. Second slot is the rate written as a percentage (scale 100).

claims.sentence: Letting a coverage diagnostic acquire stopping authority yields recall 0.555556 and again closes every task prematurely.
claims.note: Coverage-authority negative control.

claims.sentence: Removing content-identity deduplication is less catastrophic but measurably wasteful in the controlled world: mean duplicate-processing rate rises from 0 to 0.101429, five of 20 tasks exhaust the read budget, pass rate falls from 0.95 to 0.70, and mean recall falls to 0.966667.
claims.note: Dedup efficiency ablation.

claims.sentence: Removing the question coordinate from the read ledger leaves aggregate recall unchanged at 0.994444 but changes the extraction-question-shift mechanism exactly where expected: the mean count of legitimate rereads on that family falls from 4.0 to 1.0.
claims.note: H4 mechanism diagnostic, null on aggregate recall.

claims.sentence: The lexical route contributes 3.0 first relevant identities per task on average.
claims.note: Reference route contribution.

claims.sentence: Semantic and citation routes each contribute 2.0 additional identities, reformulation contributes 1.0, and the restricted route contributes 0.95; the last mean is below one because one task becomes censored.
claims.note: Per-route contribution.

claims.sentence: Conversely, lexical and semantic have nonzero mean overlap (0.079167) but remain structurally independent because neither backend nor query derivation is shared.
claims.note: Overlap is measured; independence is structural.

claims.sentence: Full ORION has no terminal failure classification: 19 tasks pass and one is censored.
claims.note: No terminal failure class for full ORION.

claims.sentence: Full ORION makes one route-stop false positive in 100 route-stop events (0.01): the unavailable restricted-route case still has a theoretically reachable gold identity and route-call budget when the route stops.
claims.note: O1 route-stop false positive, published rather than omitted.

claims.sentence: Among the 99 ORION task-routes that reach the O1 oracle exhaustion point, there are zero route-stop false negatives.
claims.note: Null-on-FN result, reported as a null.

claims.sentence: The restricted route records 19 post-exhaustion attempts, exactly one allowed confirming attempt on each of the 19 non-censored tasks; no route takes the two or more further attempts required for an O1 false negative.
claims.note: Post-exhaustion attempt accounting.

claims.sentence: Therefore the externally supported discovery-benefit claim remains CANNOT_CHECK.
claims.note: External benefit held at CANNOT_CHECK.

claims.sentence: Finally, removing the unavailable-route open state leaves mean recall numerically unchanged but turns the one censored CANNOT_CHECK case into an asserted completion and a premature-closure failure.
claims.note: Safety negative control: censoring semantics change while recall does not.

claims.sentence: Under the evaluator's fixed terminal-failure precedence, premature closure is the dominant failure class in the controlled companion; the exploratory adaptive comparator also exposes three transport-failure classifications, while the no-dedup ablation exposes five budget-exhaustion failures.
claims.note: Failure-class distribution under the evaluator's fixed precedence.

claims.sentence: The O4 unavailable-route obligation remains open, so ORION returns CANNOT_CHECK rather than asserting task completeness.
claims.note: Open obligation prevents task closure; ORION returns CANNOT_CHECK.

claims.sentence: This null-on-FN result is reported rather than being silently omitted, and it demonstrates why route-stop error and task-stop safety must be measured separately.
claims.note: The null is published rather than omitted.

claims.sentence: The access audit establishes that AutoResearchBench Wide scoring is credential-free and that MetaSyn retrieval/screening scoring does not itself need an LLM credential; it does not turn those audits into system outcomes.
claims.note: Credential-free scoring is an access fact, not a system outcome.

claims.sentence: The controlled-index result supports only the narrower statement that the frozen governance mechanisms behave as designed under a complete denominator and matched host-owned budgets.
claims.note: Explicit scope limitation of the offline result.

claims.not_asserted_reason: The completed MetaSyn ID-only probe is archived and official, but the manuscript does not yet report it. The probe is a keyless BM25 + deterministic screening candidate, not the matched multi-provider ORION system, so it may not be written as an ORION external result. Recorded here so the archived evidence cannot be quietly lost, and so that asserting it later requires promoting this row.
claims.sentence: The credential-free 86-review external probe completed under the pinned official MetaSyn ID-only evaluator with retrieval recall 0.7485, inclusion recall 0.5651, post-retrieval loss 0.1834 and screening accuracy 0.7228.
claims.note: External official probe; bounded scope, not an ORION superiority result.

non_claim_sentences.sentence: Scientific-literature discovery remains a distinct bottleneck even when downstream synthesis is fluent.
non_claim_sentences.reason: Problem framing. Asserts a motivating condition of the field, not an ORION outcome.

non_claim_sentences.sentence: ORION Paper II studies a narrow governance hypothesis: heterogeneous search routes should count as independent evidence channels only when independence is earned through backend, query-derivation and capture identity; read history should be conditioned on the scientific question and content version; stopping one route must not certify task-level completeness; unavailable or censored routes remain explicit open obligations; and promotion should be recall-first against strong simple baselines.
non_claim_sentences.reason: States the hypothesis under test and the design commitments it implies. A hypothesis statement is not a result; the result it predicts is ledgered as P2-C01.

non_claim_sentences.sentence: Open-world completeness remains generally unprovable from finite search.
non_claim_sentences.reason: Theoretical limit of finite search, not a measured outcome of this campaign.

non_claim_sentences.sentence: Rows without an archived supporting result remain CANNOT_CHECK; an access audit or implementation test cannot substitute for a system outcome.
non_claim_sentences.reason: Describes this ledger's own promotion rule rather than asserting a result.

non_claim_sentences.sentence: Figure exposes why ORION does not equate numerical disjointness with route independence.
non_claim_sentences.reason: Interpretive pointer to a figure. The measured overlap it refers to is ledgered as P2-R20.

non_claim_sentences.sentence: The independence decision is therefore made from capture construction, while overlap remains a measured diagnostic.
non_claim_sentences.reason: Design statement about how independence is decided, not a measured outcome.
